> MIH GEMS is a private atelier for natural, hand-selected coloured gemstones
> and bespoke sterling silver jewellery. Established 1998, part of the MIH
> GROUP, third-generation family business. Natural gemstones, birthstones,
> precious and semi-precious stones, moissanite jewellery, silver rings,
> customised jewellery. Wholesale and retail. Worldwide shipping.
> enquiry-based sales — no online checkout. Contact: mihgems@gmail.com
> Instagram: @mih_gems_
